title: Greer says the octagon craft is made by Lockheed Skunk Works

tellings.quote: I mean, it's been talked about publicly by Greer, but he always says that he knows the craft you saw, the souped up version of the agon retrieved is made by the Lockheit skull works in North Brumit.

plain: A souped-up version of a retrieved octagon-shaped craft is built by Lockheed's Skunk Works, its secret aircraft design division, at a place the speaker calls North Brumit, according to Steven Greer, a man who talks publicly about UFOs. The claim is repeated on the show by a guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb (UAP being the official term for unexplained flying objects), who tells a fellow guest that Greer says he knows the very craft that guest saw. If true, the object would be a human-made machine copied from a recovered one.
